name: Bramen Moric
keeps: the checkpoint, and what it was taken over
does: Replays the chain from nothing and says whether the balance is the sum of the events. Signs when it is.

text: Bramen moric of the second bell, keeps the book for the 4th tranche, doors 29 to 38. Keeps the checkpoint, and what it was taken over. Reads Paracelsus.
